 Introduction 
The Scholar Meeting of International Tax Researchers (ScholarMIT) is an annual gathering in our Amsterdam Headquarters where early-career tax scholars can discuss their ongoing projects amongst contemporaries in the field. 
 Description 
The Scholar Meeting of International Tax Researchers (ScholarMIT) is designed for early-career tax scholars who have obtained their PhD and are under the age of 50. 
This event, held at the IBFD Head Office in Amsterdam on 1-2 February 2027, provides a dynamic platform for researchers to discuss their ongoing projects, receive expert coaching, and exchange innovative ideas with colleagues from around the world. What is the eligibility criteria? 
A maximum of 12 researchers will be admitted, selected based on the quality and originality of their research. We are looking for applicants who: 
• Applicants must spend at least 30% of their work time on research-related activities. 
• Be developing an innovative research project on international, European, or comparative taxation. 
• University professors and lecturers are particularly encouraged to apply. How do you apply? 
Upload a short CV, a synopsis of your research ( use this template ), and your PhD certificate at this link by 1 September 2026. 
• Selected participants will be announced by 15 September 2026. 
• Final materials are due by 1 December 2026. Venue 
IBFD office, Amsterdam
